canonical.title: IT and tech events within 30 km of Memories (Bad Ragaz)

parent.title: Weekend at Bad Ragaz, anchored on Memories

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Memories
siblings.summary: Picks for sleeping within a few minutes' walk of Sven Wassmer Memories, from the on-property Quellenhof to budget self-check-in rooms in the village.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Memories
siblings.summary: Six character-driven alternatives to the Grand Resort, each within a short taxi of Memories — from a 4-room Bündner village hotel to a converted wine barrel above Heidi's house.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Memories
siblings.summary: Six categories of day-trips within 30 km of Memories at Grand Resort Bad Ragaz — keyed to a late-May 2026 weekend, with what's open, what's snowed-out, and what to skip.

sources.title: Digital Summit 2026
sources.claim: Digital Summit 2026 is the cross-border digital conference held 24 March 2026, 13:30, at Vaduzer-Saal in Vaduz; ninth edition.

sources.title: Digital Summit 2026 — Vaduz tourism
sources.claim: Digital Summit 2026 theme is 'Global Technology Meets European Sovereignty' with 450+ decision-makers; speakers include NVIDIA, ETH Zurich, Palantir.

sources.title: Cyber Security Workshop 2026
sources.claim: Cyber Security Workshop on 3 March 2026 at Technopark Liechtenstein, Vaduz, organised by digital-liechtenstein.li with sl.one, ensec AG and the Office for Cyber Security; ~40 SME and enterprise attendees.

sources.title: KI-Meetup Graubünden Nr. 6
sources.claim: KI-Meetup Graubünden Nr. 6 took place Wednesday 18 February 2026, 17:00–19:00, at ibW Höhere Fachschule Südostschweiz in Chur; free, registration required.

sources.title: KI-Meetup Graubünden Nr. 7
sources.claim: KI-Meetup Graubünden Nr. 7 held 20 May 2026 at FHGR Service Innovation Lab (Pulvermühlestrasse 57, 7000 Chur), keynote 'AI Beyond the Hype' by Süsstrunk & Weichselbraun; organised by Markenkern AG with GRdigital and Code Crush.

sources.title: Digitaltag Vaduz 2026
sources.claim: Digitaltag Vaduz 2026 runs Friday 20 November 2026, 17:00–22:00, at Kunstmuseum Vaduz; theme is the influence of digitalisation and AI on daily life.

sources.title: OCLA 2026
sources.claim: OCLA 2026 symposium ran 26 March 2026, 09:00–19:00, in Buchs SG; focused on optical coatings, laser technology and LIDT measurement; organised by RhySearch.

sources.title: RhySearch events
sources.claim: RhySearch in Buchs hosts Technologietag (9 June 2026, theme 'Cooperation as a Driver of Innovation'), Unternehmertag Liechtenstein (30 June 2026), and PreXcon — The Precision Technology Convention (3 November 2026).

sources.title: FHGR events
sources.claim: FHGR Infotag (open-day for IT/AI/Computational Science programmes) is held 29 and 31 October 2026 in Chur.

sources.title: Technopark Liechtenstein
sources.claim: Technopark Liechtenstein at Schaanerstrasse 27, Vaduz, hosts a year-round programme of startup lectures, workshops, pitches and discussion rounds covering pitching, growth hacking, agile development and exit strategy.

sources.title: UX Meetup Chur
sources.claim: UX Meetup Chur, ~166 members, meets irregularly at FHGR, Werkstatt LABOR and KostBar Sennhof on UX, usability and human-centred design.

sources.title: Cybersecurity Konferenz / Roundtable
sources.claim: digital-liechtenstein.li runs a recurring Cybersecurity Roundtable / Konferenz series in Liechtenstein focused on digital resilience and KMU/enterprise practice.

sources.title: Rome2Rio Vaduz–Chur
sources.claim: Vaduz to Chur driving distance is about 31 km via the A13; Bad Ragaz sits between the two, ~14 km from Vaduz and ~21 km from Chur.

sources.title: Wirtschaftsforum Südostschweiz 2026
sources.claim: Wirtschaftsforum Südostschweiz 2026 is held 9 October 2026 at the AREON Eventhalle in Chur; broad business agenda with WEF CEO Alois Zwinggi and Hamilton Bonaduz CEO Thomas Liner on the speaker list.
